question: Laxmipriya Mohapatra was associated with which of the following classical dances of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• **Laxmipriya Mohapatra **was associated with **Odissi dance form.**
 
• She was the **wife **of legendary classical dancer **Kelucharan Mohapatra.**
 
• She **started **her dancing career at an early age in **1947**.

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d004e5089b6fb9dbb6c97a9a784c238f481e7f73e7e0fbe5564675739333d34.png]
